title: Girl who got to hear their fav song live again and is going to be ok....
transcript: Just had the most incredible morning. And y'all get excited for what I saw today because I was invited to go to public studio, across the street from the Public Theatre, to catch a preview of the American cast of Benjamin Button. Oh, my gosh. They have just started rehearsals, so they're still very much in the rehearsal process, but already it sounds incredible. Like just getting to hear the score again. Tears. Instant tears. Benjamin Button was my favourite musical of all of last year, and so I've been so looking forward to seeing it again in the States. And this cast is so freaking good. But not only that, if you are a hardcore Benjamin Button fan like myself, they've made changes. There are definitely changes from the West End production to now. I cannot wait to see how it all goes together. But even today, I heard stuff that I never heard before. Now, we were not allowed to film inside, but they were filming with the professional Public footage, so I imagine you'll get clips of it eventually. I truly cannot wait to see this production. It does not start until the beginning of October, so they have just over a month left in this rehearsal period. But, y'all, it truly cannot be October fast enough. I cannot wait. And I cannot wait for more of y'all to see this, because truly an exceptional musical.
classificationReason: Creator attended a rehearsal preview of the American cast of Benjamin Button, sharing anticipation and noting changes from the West End production. The show is not on the provided list, and no final production opinion is given — it's a preview/anticipation piece.
